title: Mixed-breed dogs more badly behaved, vets warn 兽医警告：杂交犬更易出现不良行为

paragraphs.zh: 英国皇家兽医学院的一项新研究显示，像可卡贵宾犬、拉布拉多贵宾犬和卡瓦贵宾犬这类杂交犬，比它们的纯种双亲更容易表现出 “不良行为”。

paragraphs.en: Doodle dogs , bred from a poodle crossed with a different breed , have grown in popularity in recent years, but the Royal Veterinary College says they don't always behave as expected, particularly around training, anxiety and aggression .
paragraphs.zh: “杂交贵宾犬”，也就是贵宾犬和其它犬种的杂交后代，近年来大受青睐。但皇家兽医学院表示，这类混种犬的行为表现并不总能如人所愿，尤其是在受训能力、焦虑情绪和攻击性方面。

paragraphs.en: It questioned the owners of more than 9,000 dogs in the UK, looking at doodles and the parent breeds.
paragraphs.zh: 这项研究调查了英国 9000 多名犬主，对比了杂交贵宾犬和它们亲代品种的情况。

paragraphs.en: The researchers found where there were differences, the doodle breeds behaviours were more undesirable in eight out of ten cases.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员发现，在存在差异的行为对比中，杂交贵宾犬的行为在 80% 的情况下表现得更不理想。

paragraphs.en: The most common issues were fear of loud noises, separation anxiety and problems with training.
paragraphs.zh: 最常见的问题包括害怕巨大噪音、分离焦虑和训练困难。
